proposals.evidence: DEDR3999 explicitly gives Gondi paḍana/paṛana/paṛna/padna old. Survey patana is a same-language old-family candidate retaining source dental-stop voicing and vowels; panta/panda and Indo-Aryan junal/purano responses are not merged here. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR588 gives Telugu uḍuku heat and Koya Gondi uḍk ēru hot water, with Kuwi uḍku heat. Survey uḍuku/uḍukkɨ hot is a comparative extension of that heat noun. The entry explicitly calls Keikadi udku a Telugu loan, but does not settle the transmission route of these two survey lects; no specific donor is asserted. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
